name: VLB
recent: Vestland 于 2026 年 9 月完成约 9443 万股私募新股发行，发行价 RM0.70，新股已于 9 月 11 日上市。同期 CFO 与合约总经理在公开市场各减持 15 万股。最新季度（2026 年 6 月 30 日止）营收与净利均环比、同比上升。
notable: 完成私募配售 94,430,800 股新股，发行价 RM0.70，新股于 2026 年 9 月 11 日上市。
2026 年 9 月 15 日董事部变动：Miss Soo Pat Li 卸任。
risks: 私募新股占发行前股本约 10%，对现有股东持股比例有摊薄影响。
首席财务官 Low Choon Wei 于 2026 年 9 月 7 日减持 150,000 股。
合约总经理 Ooi Yiqing 于 2026 年 9 月 7 日减持 150,000 股。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收 RM250.24 million，环比增 25.4%、同比增 17.4%；净利 RM11.95 million，环比增 47.9%、同比增 11.8%；净利率 4.8%，高于上一季度的 4.1%。

recent_en: Vestland completed a private placement of about 94.43 million new shares at RM0.70 in September 2026, with the shares listed on 11 September. Over the same period, the CFO and the General Manager of Contracts each disposed of 150,000 shares in the open market. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, both revenue and net profit rose quarter-on-quarter and year-on-year.
notable_en: Completed a private placement of 94,430,800 new shares at RM0.70, with the shares listed on 11 September 2026.
Boardroom change on 15 September 2026: Miss Soo Pat Li stepped down.
risks_en: The private placement of new shares represented about 10% of the pre-issue share base, diluting existing shareholders' stakes.
Chief Financial Officer Low Choon Wei disposed of 150,000 shares on 7 September 2026.
General Manager of Contracts Ooi Yiqing disposed of 150,000 shares on 7 September 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM250.24 million, up 25.4% quarter-on-quarter and 17.4% year-on-year; net profit was RM11.95 million, up 47.9% quarter-on-quarter and 11.8% year-on-year; net margin was 4.8%, higher than 4.1% in the previous quarter.
